context: Two bins at each stage, divided at fitting-split median of mean observed log-signal over prefix. Only original-policy observed histories; no information scores, theta or expert IDs.
intervention: Keep original top-two routed experts and all original top-three slot weights. Replace third/weakest selected slot by target e if e is not in top-two; otherwise no-op. Exactly three DISTINCT experts and identical total gate mass. All other modules frozen. Intervene once; rerun all subsequent adaptive observations/decisions.
expert_comparison_estimand: Mean terminal sPCE difference within frozen observable bin AND common eligibility for both compared candidates (neither in kept top-two). Do not rank experts across different eligibility domains.
router_comparison: Per prefix, average four unselected-eligible substitutions minus original selection. Paired mean by context; lower utility for alternatives supports original router only on this intervention domain.
utility: Native full-horizon T30 explicit-likelihood sPCE including truth in denominator; same exogenous truth/noise/shared prior contrast bank across all policies in a phase. Independent phase banks. MCSE conditional on shared contrast bank.
multiplicity: Two-sided normal-approximation Bonferroni family316 per heldout/confirmation phase:56expert-versus-native context means+168pairwise expert/context means+84context interactions+8router aggregate means. Alpha.05. Report point and simultaneous CIs. Require independent confirmation with same sign, not isolated maxima.
success: At least one same expert-pair/stage has opposite context advantages exceeding0.02nats with simultaneous CIs excluding those margins in BOTH heldout and confirmation; context interaction simultaneous CI excludes0; >=128common-eligible cases each bin. No architecture superiority claim.
